additional_observations.pack_a_domain_e_items: Pack A contains original P1-E-xxx QIDs (P1-E-001 through P1-E-084 with gaps), all marked 'Certified'. These are distinct from the P1-E-R## replacements in Pack E. The P1-E-xxx naming convention predates the replacement scheme and represents the originally distributed Domain E items across packs.
additional_observations.pack_b_domain_e_absence: Pack B has zero Domain E items of any kind — no P1-E-xxx, no P1-E-R##, no P1-EC-xxx, no P1-ED-xxx. This is expected if Domain E items were distributed only to packs A, C, D, and E.
additional_observations.r_item_ordering: In pack_e_corrected.js, R-items R01-R11 are in ascending order at the start, then R14-R17, R19-R20, R30-R32, R34-R36 appear, then R26-R27, R29, R37-R40 appear before R12-R13, R18, R21-R25, R28, R33 appear at the end. All 40 items are present; the non-sequential ordering may reflect insertion batch grouping.
additional_observations.source_description_consistency: Each P1-E-R## item includes a SourceDescription field documenting which archived P1-EC-xxx or P1-ED-xxx clone rotation group it replaces (e.g., 'replacing archived P1-EC-001 through P1-EC-005 clone rotation group'). Only 9 of the 40 items reference P1-ED groups; the rest reference P1-EC groups.
